# Zync

> Watch Together, Perfectly In Sync

Zync is a real-time collaborative watch-party web application that synchronizes YouTube video playback across multiple participants in rooms.

## Features
- Real-time video synchronization (play, pause, seek, change video) with drift correction.
- Room-based watch parties with 8-character unique room codes.
- Granular Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): Host, Moderator, Participant, and Viewer.
- Server-side role enforcement and visibility filtering.
- Interactive live chat and floating emoji reactions.
- Playback control requests with Host/Moderator approval workflows.
- Custom authentication with Brevo email OTP verification.

## Architecture
- Frontend: React 18, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, YouTube IFrame API.
- Backend: Node.js, Express, Socket.IO with OOP architecture (Room, Participant, RoleManager, MessageHandler).
- Database & Cache: PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM, Redis for Socket.IO horizontal scaling.
